title: Power Apps: Card gallery, Persona, Avatar group and Metrics card canvas controls reach general availability
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, maker-side setting and documented control behaviour remain supported. The changed overview retains the stated settings path, and the previously rate-limited sources were readable. Minor corrections should acknowledge the published app-level licensing options and cite the source explaining whose details Persona's defaults display.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans general availability for Card gallery, Persona, Avatar group and Metrics card canvas controls.
claims.quote:
The following controls for canvas apps are reaching general availability:

•	Card gallery

•	Persona

•	Avatar group

•	Metrics card

claims.where: controls[0].ui; What's changing; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: With a canvas app open for editing, the Power Apps maker path is Settings > Updates > New > Modern controls and themes.
claims.quote: With your canvas app open for editing: 1. On the command bar, select Settings > Updates. 2. Select the New tab and then turn on Modern controls and themes.

claims.claim: Modern controls and themes is a per-app authoring setting, rather than a documented administrator policy.
claims.quote: Enable modern controls and themes for your app. With your canvas app open for editing: 1. On the command bar, select Settings > Updates. 2. Select the New tab and then turn on Modern controls and themes.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not document the modern controls setting as governing these four controls individually.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps modern controls themes enable administrator policy PowerShell Power Platform API pac canvas setting; Card gallery Persona Avatar group Metrics card rollout existing apps required role administrator. Read overview, reference and four control pages; no individual switches found.

claims.claim: No automation operation for the per-app Modern controls and themes toggle is documented.

claims.quote: Name - The primary text line and the name used to derive avatar initials. The default is User().FullName.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Persona's Caption defaults to User().Email.
claims.quote: Caption - The secondary text line. The default is User().Email.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Persona's Image defaults to User().Image.
claims.quote: Image - The image displayed in the avatar. The default is User().Image. When the image is blank or unavailable, the avatar displays initials derived from Name.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Persona's default User() formulas refer to the name, email and image of the user signed in to the canvas app.
claims.quote: In Power Apps, show the full name, the email address, and the picture that's associated with the user who's signed in to a canvas app.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/show-current-user to sources for the explanation of whose details the User() defaults display.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; summary; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Licensing is unknown because no licence specific to the four controls is published.
claims.quote: While Power Apps Premium, Power Apps per app plans, and the Power Apps per app pay-as-you-go meter that give premium Power Apps usage rights satisfy the requirement generally, use rights differ by license and by the context the app runs in.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included. Replace the opening licensing gap wording with: 'The controls use the app's existing Power Apps entitlement; premium app options include Power Apps Premium, Power Apps per app plans and the Power Apps per-app pay-as-you-go meter. No licence or meter specific to these four controls is published.' Retain the existing premium-connector and pay-as-you-go explanations. Apply the same narrower gap wording in the summary, licensing notes, cost rationale and licensing open question. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/powerapps-licensing-faq.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The four control pages name no licence or meter specific to the controls.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Card gallery Persona Avatar group Metrics card license licensing pricing meter. Read all four modern control pages, Power Apps licensing FAQs and pay-as-you-go meter excerpts; no control-specific licence or meter found.

claims.claim: The roadmap item names no licence for the four controls.
claims.quote: These controls provide reusable patterns for responsive record cards, individual and grouped identities, and key metrics. Makers supply data, presence values, and metric calculations through properties and Power Fx.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Apps using premium connectors need an appropriate Power Apps entitlement.
claims.quote: End users need an entitlement to access a premium app. Some examples of features that require premium entitlements include: premium connectors, Dataverse entities, on-premises data gateways, custom APIs, etc.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The Power Apps per-app pay-as-you-go meter supports app access without a standalone Power Apps licence.
claims.quote: The Power Apps per-app meter enables users to use any type of app without needing to have a Power Apps license. The Power Apps per-app meter provides access to both canvas, and model-driven apps for authenticated users.

claims.claim: Persona has no Studio upgrade action from another control, so adoption requires manual app changes.
claims.quote: Persona is a new control. Studio doesn't offer an upgrade action from another control. Persona has no automatic upgrade path from another control.

claims.claim: No required role specific to these four controls is stated beyond their Learn descriptions.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Card gallery Persona Avatar group Metrics card rollout existing apps required role administrator. Read roadmap, overview, reference and all four control pages; no control-specific role requirement found.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated a rollout mechanism specific to these four controls.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Card gallery Persona Avatar group Metrics card rollout existing apps required role administrator. Read roadmap, overview, reference and all four control pages; no feature-specific rollout mechanism found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Existing canvas app connection and data-sharing permissions govern access to the resources makers bind into these apps.
claims.quote: Other connections require users to create their own connections and explictly grant security privileges (such as security roles for the Dataverse, OneDrive for Business, SQL Server with Microsoft Entra authentication).
